versions.changelog: 索引范围扩展(MEMORY.md+根目录文件)+精简SKILL.md+修package.json

Initial release of semantic-memory-search.

- Adds vector-driven semantic search for OpenClaw memory files using the memsearch library
- Supports hybrid search (dense vectors + BM25), RRF reranking, and SHA-256 based deduplication
- Enables local embedding (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) with no API Key required
- Stores data locally with Milvus Lite and supports offline use
- Includes file monitoring and incremental updates for automatic reindexing
- Integrates directly with OpenClaw
